rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: All three Core entries say Instantaneous while the native text creates a zone, point or field with continuing utility.
options: Select and justify finite spell-local duration/concentration for each continuing effect, retaining Instantaneous as source conflict.
Provide a genuinely useful instantaneous operation only where the complete source effect can be fulfilled; do not silently discard continuing field utility.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose explicitly for each identity. Reuse accepted elapsed/regular-marker conventions by exact scope; new duration/concentration numbers are NEW scoped authorship, not recovered source or mandatory tabletop simplification.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core provides Action,120 feet,V/S/F and26 baseRP but no zone radius, shape, point influence volume or mobile-anchor permission.
options: Specify finite geometry, legal placement, clipping and fixed/moving behavior separately for each identity.
Adopt a particular existing geometry contract by explicit scoped reference and justify any changed dimensions.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep the printed120-foot placement range. Resolve occupied-body versus origin/payload eligibility at the actual relevant checkpoint, actual elevation/line of effect, tangency, barriers and unsupported space. A point does not imply infinite global reach, and no radius may be passed off as printed.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Field creation and ending interact with actual cast commitment, concentration transitions, payment, interruption, suppression and replacement.
options: One application identity with explicit creation/activation/end states and original deadline.
A separately justified staged construction, retaining full costs and state transitions.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Use settled casting and concentration contracts. Define successful placement versus countered/failed creation, later expiry/removal, old cleanup versus replacement, relocation/planar absence, and save restoration. Do not return spent costs or reset deadline/history on re-entry.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Greater Dispel, Lesser Antimagic, Null damage provenance and specific source immunities are already reviewed; these new fields have no automatic blanket override.
options: Provide spell-local interfaces that preserve exact accepted source predicates and suppression clocks.
Declare a narrow new exception only if necessary to preserve the printed spell and disclose affected interfaces.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Distinguish absorption, countering, dispelling and suppression. Supply genuine removal/suppression cases and Null branches only when the actual provenance qualifies. Do not let the word all override relic/cosmology decisions or automatically erase every magical creature/item.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Arc Furnace says allies' spell damage +50% in zone; it does not specify which actor, target, origin or damage location must be in that zone.
options: Qualify the allied originating caster at a stated checkpoint and preserve qualifying downstream damage provenance.
Qualify damage recipients/locations within the field, with a stated allied-source predicate.
Select another exact source-faithful location predicate with complete examples.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select one meaningful interpretation explicitly. Resolve caster inclusion, actual ally relation changes, hostile copies/charm, remote familiar/Echo origins and allies outside attacking in. Never silently change allies to everyone or in-zone to unlimited assistance.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The native numerical benefit is +50% spell damage. Core rounds fractions down unless expressly overridden; existing damage stages include saves, typed defenses, reductions, sharing and tempHP.
options: Apply one explicit1.5 multiplier at a named existing damage stage with defined typed-packet allocation and rounding.
Apply a separately authored equivalent +floor(base/2) addition, showing equivalence and any mixed-type difference.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve the real50% benefit, not a small flat substitute. questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Retain actual useful combat amplification and disclose player-facing cues. Do not import Eternal Forge, repair, smelting, item creation, harvestable fuel or extra fire damage from the name.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source supplies a point and absorption but does not identify interception stage or whether one intercepted part cancels an entire remote cast.

selectedSharedRules.classification: NEW spell-local finite-field completion using the named accepted casting/Ready interfaces
selectedSharedRules.text: These three spells alone use one Action, placement range120ft, V/S/F, actual rank9/base26RP and their exact native acquisition rows. Each creates a fixed, visible, nonphysical field with concentration for at most60 elapsed seconds from actual establishment, not preparation or commitment. Original Core Instantaneous metadata is retained as a conflict, not selected as the field lifetime. Field instances have stable owner, paid-cast and application IDs; precise establishment sequence, original deadline, current active/suppressed/ended state and no reset on movement, extra turns, saving/loading or reentry. A legal commitment pays its final affordable actual price, performs components, spends the Action and updates class/encounter history once before its one counter window. The incompatible previous concentration ends at that commitment before the final eligibility/price is evaluated; if this makes the final transaction unaffordable, do not commit the new cast or end the old source. Preflight calculates this post-transition quote without mutation. A committed countered/failed cast never restores the displaced source. Prospective concentration begins at commitment; the field is absent until successful establishment. Ordinary Ready pays at preparation, establishes only at surviving release, retains its real Reaction/trigger/target/next-regular-START and any earlier source deadline, and never pays or updates casting history again. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 applies only where its seven actual copied-feat profiles independently allow that source; it grants no rank9 payload permission or extra Action. These fields do not grant concentration slots. A source-qualified Tether remains separately acquired/paid and uses its own duration; no fixture silently activates it. At expiry or actual concentration loss, actual eligible dispel/removal, actual creator death, or loss of the authoritative same-plane field anchor, end this field once. Voluntary concentration release follows the ordinary rule. Planar separation of the creator alone does not move or automatically delete the anchored field; inability to maintain concentration follows its actual source. No field grants support, cover, heat, solid collision, magical components, loot or a hidden object to harvest.

Furnace and Supreme Nexus are radius30ft spheres; Singularity is a radius10ft sphere around its specified point. Choose a perceived same-plane point within120ft of the actual permitted casting origin and actual line of effect. The fixed anchor may be in air; no floor or support is required because this is not a body. Actual solid total cover clips each field radially from its center. A body qualifies if its interior has a nonempty intersection with the operative volume; boundary-only tangency does not qualify. Point anchors and source origins use closed distance<=radius with a genuinely unblocked center-to-point path; a point hidden inside solid terrain or a closed opaque object that prevents the required placement line is illegal. Because these fields have no body, an unoccupied center is not required: the caster may use its own actual casting origin, and a perceived creature's occupied space is not automatically an illegal solid-terrain center. This supplies no view through an opaque barrier or concealed interior. Use actual current bodies, not five-foot centers alone, and preserve source-required paths and target restrictions. No straight-line projectile is invented for a nonprojectile spell, teleport, thought or area. Ordinary field entry/exit creates no Action, attack, RNG, reveal, price recomputation or release. The created fields remain visibly identifiable as a damage-support forge-pattern, absorbing point, or enhancement lattice, but have no magical detection benefit. No later movement of a creator recenters them.

selectedSharedRules.classification: NEW finite ordering only for interactions involving these fields
selectedSharedRules.text: Use the actual scheduler timestamp and authoritative event sequence, not player descriptions. Source deadlines/ordinary required teardown win at equality. Then complete the legally due parent trigger and declared cast/Ready checkpoint, source-specific concentration transition, final price/atomic payment/history and existing LIFO counter windows. Surviving effect resolution queries actual operative fields: first actual source prohibitions and Lesser Antimagic suppression, then Singularity absorption, then surviving enhancement/attack-save/damage/healing/condition operations and ordinary consequences. Do not draw an absorbed target's attack/save or effect dice; one area shared pool is still drawn once if any unabsorbed recipient requires it. Complete source-qualified on-resolution refunds before settling that source's pending conversion entitlement. A committed reaction remains governed by its real trigger; fields grant none. Same-time creations are sequenced by authoritative creation sequence then stable application ID. Only already-established eligible Singularity instances may intercept a new field's formation before insertion. A field is never its own input. Between already-existing fields use the same oldest eligible absorber then application-ID rule, marking a local consumption receipt before removal callbacks. Removed absorbers do no later work in the queue. Each local manifestation and each source-use conversion receipt can transition once; teardown, conversion credits, pricing discounts and informational cues are terminal bookkeeping, not new absorbable spell casts or recursively amplifiable magical payloads. A committed source-derived recurring pulse is an output, not a fresh price or conversion-origin identity unless its actual source expressly creates a separately paid activation. This is a local dispatch integration requirement, not a proof that a game scheduler implements it.

selectedSharedRules.classification: NEW Supreme-only insertion; preserves accepted AC5/AC6 bucket order outside this insertion
selectedSharedRules.text: Validate source entitlement and actual body at the real payment checkpoint. Start creditableBase B after actual source/class base-only reductions, waivers and their own minima; E is genuinely discountable ordinary extras including applicable strain/optional RP extras. Keep named protected principal P separate: Barrier X, Forge cycle5, actual Conduit/Transfusion transfer value and any other source that expressly protects its principal. HP, materials, charges, uses, RC and non-RP currencies are not B or E. Source ownership and rank never change with price. For an actual spell, apply one operative ordinary Nexus -2 to B first, then E. For a qualifying Supreme activation, let T=B+E and savings=ceil(T/2); subtract savings from B first and then E, yielding floor(T/2). Thus half of an odd combined price is computed once, not separately per bucket. This explicit allocation controls actually-paid-base attribution. Add accepted spell-only Dampening +2 afterward; then apply one real pending final Influence: Ease subtracts base first, then E, then Dampening, floor0; Burden is noncreditable. Finally add protected P in full. There is no new Supreme minimum: a1RP discountable amount becomes0. Existing source minima govern their own preceding calculation; an exact source prohibition on reduction still governs its protected amount. Neither ordinary Nexus nor Dampening/Influence becomes a nonspell rule. Supreme expressly also halves a genuinely magical nonspell activation's actual ordinary RP fee at its own commitment, after that source's reductions, but not protected transfers/principal; it neither supplies a missing RP pool nor invents an RP price for a charge-only or RC source. An independently defined recurring magical service fee can qualify at each real new payment; ongoing concentration itself is not a payment. Pending rank9 Perfect Spell/Perfection/Ascendance and other unselected cost replacements are not rules here. Barrier/other actual-paid-base outputs use the retained B, never a nominal full base or saved RP. Exact eligible base refunds see this same actual B, only at their actual triggers and frequency. No discount is a recovery credit.

selectedSharedRules.classification: NEW multiplier stage only; inherited source damage/life/Null order remains
selectedSharedRules.text: For surviving eligible damage, preserve the complete source's hit/save sequence, native dice and real source-specific class/rider stages. Criticals double only actually eligible dice before this amplification. At the ordinary pre-save raw-damage stage combine the eligible Furnace3/2 and Supreme5/4 rational multipliers and floor once on the combined nonnegative typed packet, not once per source. Allocate that total proportionally to the original nonnegative typed parts: floor each exact share, then distribute the remaining points by descending fractional remainder, stable normalized damage-type name and original component ordinal. One multiplier application does not create another hit/root/Wound check. Then use the source's stated per-type save-success rule and actual typed defenses, reduction order, pure prevention, sharing, tempHP, life and Wound rules. Source-specific later-stage bonuses such as Elemental Supremacy remain at their printed later stage and do not return through amplification. Separate hits and actual later pulses get their own permitted query; pure reflected/transferred descendants retain their already-scaled original packet and flags without re-amplification or new conversion funding. Preserve source prohibitions on external amplification, copied-feat payload budgets, recovery funding, intrinsic class engines and relic properties. The actual original damage dealer—not a field supporter—is recorded on each source-authorized root. A true creation-time Null flag remains unchanged on all descendants; later field eligibility does not resnapshot it. A separately created later root follows its exact accepted source. Absorption is not damage, cannot create a Wound, damage-based recovery or kill credit, and creates no fictitious prevented-damage root.

selectedSharedRules.classification: NEW receipt obligations; no runtime persistence claim
selectedSharedRules.text: Authoritative field, cast, paid-base, refund, continuous-source, child-manifestation, conversion, pending-credit and effect-lifecycle IDs survive reloads. A pending receipt must resume its one recorded transaction, not recompute from a client preview or current nominal rank price. RNG faces are consumed only by the actual underlying outcome; a failed validation, duplicate callback or absorbed output cannot consume another draw. Current observers see permitted audiovisual cues and their own actual pool/result changes only. Private source IDs, hidden casters, invisible inventories, protected motives, local false-target classification and absorbed-category records remain private. Previewing a price cannot activate absorption, spend Influence, consume RNG, leak a roster or supply a sixth DE4 presentation. Unknown source qualification is resolved using ordinary authoritative hidden data without a new diagnostic. Expected field benefits do not grant repertoire, attunement, recipes, knowledge, resources, extra phases, real-time/turn-mode policy or cosmology. The original all-magic promise is fulfilled through the category map, not a damage-only whitelist; a genuinely undefined external magical source needs its own native adapter without disabling these complete ordinary positive procedures.

commonClauses.classification: NEW spell-local finite-field completion using the named accepted casting/Ready interfaces
commonClauses.text: These three spells alone use one Action, placement range120ft, V/S/F, actual rank9/base26RP and their exact native acquisition rows. Each creates a fixed, visible, nonphysical field with concentration for at most60 elapsed seconds from actual establishment, not preparation or commitment. Original Core Instantaneous metadata is retained as a conflict, not selected as the field lifetime. Field instances have stable owner, paid-cast and application IDs; precise establishment sequence, original deadline, current active/suppressed/ended state and no reset on movement, extra turns, saving/loading or reentry. A legal commitment pays its final affordable actual price, performs components, spends the Action and updates class/encounter history once before its one counter window. The incompatible previous concentration ends at that commitment before the final eligibility/price is evaluated; if this makes the final transaction unaffordable, do not commit the new cast or end the old source. Preflight calculates this post-transition quote without mutation. A committed countered/failed cast never restores the displaced source. Prospective concentration begins at commitment; the field is absent until successful establishment. Ordinary Ready pays at preparation, establishes only at surviving release, retains its real Reaction/trigger/target/next-regular-START and any earlier source deadline, and never pays or updates casting history again. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 applies only where its seven actual copied-feat profiles independently allow that source; it grants no rank9 payload permission or extra Action. These fields do not grant concentration slots. A source-qualified Tether remains separately acquired/paid and uses its own duration; no fixture silently activates it. At expiry or actual concentration loss, actual eligible dispel/removal, actual creator death, or loss of the authoritative same-plane field anchor, end this field once. Voluntary concentration release follows the ordinary rule. Planar separation of the creator alone does not move or automatically delete the anchored field; inability to maintain concentration follows its actual source. No field grants support, cover, heat, solid collision, magical components, loot or a hidden object to harvest.

Furnace and Supreme Nexus are radius30ft spheres; Singularity is a radius10ft sphere around its specified point. Choose a perceived same-plane point within120ft of the actual permitted casting origin and actual line of effect. The fixed anchor may be in air; no floor or support is required because this is not a body. Actual solid total cover clips each field radially from its center. A body qualifies if its interior has a nonempty intersection with the operative volume; boundary-only tangency does not qualify. Point anchors and source origins use closed distance<=radius with a genuinely unblocked center-to-point path; a point hidden inside solid terrain or a closed opaque object that prevents the required placement line is illegal. Because these fields have no body, an unoccupied center is not required: the caster may use its own actual casting origin, and a perceived creature's occupied space is not automatically an illegal solid-terrain center. This supplies no view through an opaque barrier or concealed interior. Use actual current bodies, not five-foot centers alone, and preserve source-required paths and target restrictions. No straight-line projectile is invented for a nonprojectile spell, teleport, thought or area. Ordinary field entry/exit creates no Action, attack, RNG, reveal, price recomputation or release. The created fields remain visibly identifiable as a damage-support forge-pattern, absorbing point, or enhancement lattice, but have no magical detection benefit. No later movement of a creator recenters them.

commonClauses.classification: NEW finite ordering only for interactions involving these fields
commonClauses.text: Use the actual scheduler timestamp and authoritative event sequence, not player descriptions. Source deadlines/ordinary required teardown win at equality. Then complete the legally due parent trigger and declared cast/Ready checkpoint, source-specific concentration transition, final price/atomic payment/history and existing LIFO counter windows. Surviving effect resolution queries actual operative fields: first actual source prohibitions and Lesser Antimagic suppression, then Singularity absorption, then surviving enhancement/attack-save/damage/healing/condition operations and ordinary consequences. Do not draw an absorbed target's attack/save or effect dice; one area shared pool is still drawn once if any unabsorbed recipient requires it. Complete source-qualified on-resolution refunds before settling that source's pending conversion entitlement. A committed reaction remains governed by its real trigger; fields grant none. Same-time creations are sequenced by authoritative creation sequence then stable application ID. Only already-established eligible Singularity instances may intercept a new field's formation before insertion. A field is never its own input. Between already-existing fields use the same oldest eligible absorber then application-ID rule, marking a local consumption receipt before removal callbacks. Removed absorbers do no later work in the queue. Each local manifestation and each source-use conversion receipt can transition once; teardown, conversion credits, pricing discounts and informational cues are terminal bookkeeping, not new absorbable spell casts or recursively amplifiable magical payloads. A committed source-derived recurring pulse is an output, not a fresh price or conversion-origin identity unless its actual source expressly creates a separately paid activation. This is a local dispatch integration requirement, not a proof that a game scheduler implements it.

commonClauses.classification: NEW Supreme-only insertion; preserves accepted AC5/AC6 bucket order outside this insertion
commonClauses.text: Validate source entitlement and actual body at the real payment checkpoint. Start creditableBase B after actual source/class base-only reductions, waivers and their own minima; E is genuinely discountable ordinary extras including applicable strain/optional RP extras. Keep named protected principal P separate: Barrier X, Forge cycle5, actual Conduit/Transfusion transfer value and any other source that expressly protects its principal. HP, materials, charges, uses, RC and non-RP currencies are not B or E. Source ownership and rank never change with price. For an actual spell, apply one operative ordinary Nexus -2 to B first, then E. For a qualifying Supreme activation, let T=B+E and savings=ceil(T/2); subtract savings from B first and then E, yielding floor(T/2). Thus half of an odd combined price is computed once, not separately per bucket. This explicit allocation controls actually-paid-base attribution. Add accepted spell-only Dampening +2 afterward; then apply one real pending final Influence: Ease subtracts base first, then E, then Dampening, floor0; Burden is noncreditable. Finally add protected P in full. There is no new Supreme minimum: a1RP discountable amount becomes0. Existing source minima govern their own preceding calculation; an exact source prohibition on reduction still governs its protected amount. Neither ordinary Nexus nor Dampening/Influence becomes a nonspell rule. Supreme expressly also halves a genuinely magical nonspell activation's actual ordinary RP fee at its own commitment, after that source's reductions, but not protected transfers/principal; it neither supplies a missing RP pool nor invents an RP price for a charge-only or RC source. An independently defined recurring magical service fee can qualify at each real new payment; ongoing concentration itself is not a payment. Pending rank9 Perfect Spell/Perfection/Ascendance and other unselected cost replacements are not rules here. Barrier/other actual-paid-base outputs use the retained B, never a nominal full base or saved RP. Exact eligible base refunds see this same actual B, only at their actual triggers and frequency. No discount is a recovery credit.

commonClauses.classification: NEW multiplier stage only; inherited source damage/life/Null order remains
commonClauses.text: For surviving eligible damage, preserve the complete source's hit/save sequence, native dice and real source-specific class/rider stages. Criticals double only actually eligible dice before this amplification. At the ordinary pre-save raw-damage stage combine the eligible Furnace3/2 and Supreme5/4 rational multipliers and floor once on the combined nonnegative typed packet, not once per source. Allocate that total proportionally to the original nonnegative typed parts: floor each exact share, then distribute the remaining points by descending fractional remainder, stable normalized damage-type name and original component ordinal. One multiplier application does not create another hit/root/Wound check. Then use the source's stated per-type save-success rule and actual typed defenses, reduction order, pure prevention, sharing, tempHP, life and Wound rules. Source-specific later-stage bonuses such as Elemental Supremacy remain at their printed later stage and do not return through amplification. Separate hits and actual later pulses get their own permitted query; pure reflected/transferred descendants retain their already-scaled original packet and flags without re-amplification or new conversion funding. Preserve source prohibitions on external amplification, copied-feat payload budgets, recovery funding, intrinsic class engines and relic properties. The actual original damage dealer—not a field supporter—is recorded on each source-authorized root. A true creation-time Null flag remains unchanged on all descendants; later field eligibility does not resnapshot it. A separately created later root follows its exact accepted source. Absorption is not damage, cannot create a Wound, damage-based recovery or kill credit, and creates no fictitious prevented-damage root.

commonClauses.classification: NEW receipt obligations; no runtime persistence claim
commonClauses.text: Authoritative field, cast, paid-base, refund, continuous-source, child-manifestation, conversion, pending-credit and effect-lifecycle IDs survive reloads. A pending receipt must resume its one recorded transaction, not recompute from a client preview or current nominal rank price. RNG faces are consumed only by the actual underlying outcome; a failed validation, duplicate callback or absorbed output cannot consume another draw. Current observers see permitted audiovisual cues and their own actual pool/result changes only. Private source IDs, hidden casters, invisible inventories, protected motives, local false-target classification and absorbed-category records remain private. Previewing a price cannot activate absorption, spend Influence, consume RNG, leak a roster or supply a sixth DE4 presentation. Unknown source qualification is resolved using ordinary authoritative hidden data without a new diagnostic. Expected field benefits do not grant repertoire, attunement, recipes, knowledge, resources, extra phases, real-time/turn-mode policy or cosmology. The original all-magic promise is fulfilled through the category map, not a damage-only whitelist; a genuinely undefined external magical source needs its own native adapter without disabling these complete ordinary positive procedures.

completeSpellSelections.name: Arc Furnace
completeSpellSelections.nativePromise: Forge of energy: allies' spell damage +50% in zone.
completeSpellSelections.procedure:
KEEP rank9/class17 Mage or Wizard through Evocation, Action/120ft/V/S/F/base26RP, plus actual class/source acquisition, cost and cadence. NEW AF9-FIELD-01: establish the fixed radius30ft,60-elapsed-second concentrating field under RF9-CAST-LIFE-01 and RF9-GEOMETRY-01. Preserve Core Instantaneous as rejected lifetime metadata. This is energy support, not a physical forge, fuel source, ambient fire attack or crafting station.

NEW AF9-QUALIFY-01: at each genuine spell damage event's source-authorized pre-defense creation checkpoint, the original damage-dealing caster must be an actual current ally of this field's original caster (self included) and that damage caster's real body must intersect the operative field with center line of effect. The recipient and actual spell area may be outside. A remote familiar/projection cannot substitute for this body. The original class/school/spell route and damage dealer remain the true source; charming/dominating/copying someone does not transfer their damage ownership or automatically make them an ally. An actual changed alliance affects the next genuine event, never a resolved/transferred child. No body in this plane, actual source suppression, or no current alliance means no Furnace bonus. This includes an ongoing spell created earlier when its next damage event genuinely qualifies; an already-created delayed root retains its original Null flag even if this event newly qualifies for Furnace.

NEW AF9-DAMAGE-01: increase all qualifying native spell damage by50%, including actual source-permitted damage dice, flat damage and attached spell damage, using RF9-PROVENANCE-01. The whole spell's magical classification, not its damage type or ordinary-vs-class name, governs. Actual class-tagged spells qualify. Mundane weapon damage, nonspell magical techniques, summoned creatures' independent attacks and resulting ordinary physical hazards are not spell damage merely because magic enabled them; their genuine spell damage riders can qualify as separately identified components. A source expressly forbidding external amplification retains that narrower protection: do not expand the seven adapted-feat profiles, a reflected damage copy or a protected conversion result. This is not Fate Echo eligibility and does not exclude an otherwise actual Cast Echo child merely for being a copied full spell.

One Furnace multiplier applies across overlapping instances; use the oldest genuinely eligible establishment then application ID for attribution. All instances retain independent concentration, coverage and clocks; ending the oldest exposes the next only for future events. Distinct Supreme enhancement can combine by the exact rational stage in RF9-PROVENANCE-01. Real class rules retain their printed stages and frequencies; Nuke Chain is not another automatic damage multiplier, actual Focus damage/riders remain once at their real trigger, and Elemental Absorption's one extra die is not Wizard Spell Absorption's temporaryHP.

NEW AF9-READY-01: preparation location does not lock Furnace damage. Price/history/components still commit once at ordinary Ready preparation; Furnace qualification is tested at the actual damage checkpoint after legal release. Preparing in/releasing out loses this bonus; preparing out/releasing in can gain it. A countered/fully absorbed/suppressed payload deals no damage to amplify. A genuine Reaction spell can qualify without another Action or fabricated trigger. A multi-target shared raw roll remains one roll; each recipient's permitted packet uses the appropriate frozen event eligibility, without changing the dice when one recipient later moves or transfers damage.

Lesser Antimagic makes covered local support inoperative while its exact clocks continue; it does not merely inspect the remote field owner's location. Actual eligible Greater Dispel captures this rank9 whole field under its real immutable snapshot/check. Singularity can consume the generator when this field anchor is admitted, or the local enhancement manifestation at its own declared checkpoint. No emitted completed damage is undone. End only under RF9-CAST-LIFE-01; leaving, reentering or inspecting never grants a fresh buff clock, resource return or hidden magical scan.

completeSpellSelections.name: Resonance Singularity
completeSpellSelections.nativePromise: Create a point that absorbs all magic and converts it to Resonance.
completeSpellSelections.procedure:
KEEP rank9/class17 Druid, Mage or Wizard through Conjuration, Action/120ft/V/S/F/base26RP. NEW RS9-FIELD-01: the point has radius10ft operative influence and60-elapsed-second concentration, with RF9-GEOMETRY-01 clipping. It is indiscriminate: own, allied and hostile magic are included, at any actual rank, damaging or not. It does not physically attract creatures, draw matter across barriers or create a cosmological void.

NEW RS9-ALL-MAGIC-01: before local magical expression, absorb actual ordinary/class spells, expressly magical nonspell activations/riders, item-spell/charge/use outputs, existing creature-attached magical applications, ongoing fields and temporary spell-sustained creations. Intrinsic learned engines, RP/RC maxima, known spells, faith, souls, real ordinary anatomy, ordinary weapon matter, permanent converted matter and completed nonmagical consequences are not active magic to annihilate. Preserve explicit source immunity, unremovable curse engines, relic clauses and anti-resource-farm predicates; all magic is not permission to invent their opposite. A native source lacking a dispel rank is not automatically immune to this distinct new absorption operation, nor is it assigned rank0. The complete category map is operative, not a whitelist of the worked examples.

NEW RS9-LOCAL-01: qualifying local output is consumed before its own attack/save/payload RNG or damage root. Use actual source origin, recipient/area manifestation, destination or traveling effect path only where that source genuinely supplies one. If the true originating manifestation is inside, the newly emitted magical payload is absorbed before leaving; do not use the remote concentrating caster as the origin of an already-established outside emitter. An outside-origin nonprojectile with all actual manifestations outside is unaffected even if a drawn chord crosses this sphere. NEW locality clarification: an instantaneous area selection/line-of-effect center is not, merely by being a geometric center, a persistent generator or a traveling emitter. For an outside-caster instantaneous area with no actual source-defined propagation/emitter, resolve simultaneous recipient-local manifestations; a center inside this sphere does not by itself erase outside recipients. An actual persistent generator or expressly defined emitted/traveling source remains interceptable under its real procedure. A multi-target cast loses admitted local applications, not uncaptured outside ones. An indivisible creature buff is consumed as a whole application when its real affected body qualifies. If a field's discrete generator anchor is admitted, end that whole field; if its anchor stays outside, intercept only local emissions/expressions, retaining the outside parent and its original clock. New lawful later emissions can resume after the absorber ends; missed damage, healing, commands or duration never replay. Absorption is not Counterspell: a legally paid source that reached actual effect resolution completes that resolution even if every local output is consumed, with only its genuinely qualified completion hooks. An actual countered or pre-resolution-aborted cast receives no such completion. No refund, vent, counter success or extra use is invented merely by naming absorption.

For a temporary body whose existence is sustained by a removable creating spell, absorption of its actual creation/sustaining application invokes its actual ending/removal lifecycle, not a generic killing attack. Real carried objects drop locally; no corpse, loot, RP or kill trigger is fabricated from a body whose source forbids it. Full creation-source suppression and absorption-as-removal are distinct operations: do not substitute an AC5/AC6 pause rule for an actual end. A permanent ordinary corpse conversion or mundane created item persists if its creation is already complete; only a still-magical component/output is intercepted. Permanent enchanted items and persistent class passives retain item/engine identity, ownership and uses. Their local magical expression is unavailable inside, but native future expression can resume outside with the same history. A consumed discrete ongoing buff does not return merely on exit. No charge is spent merely by passive presence; an actually activated item spends its native charge at commitment normally.

NEW RS9-CONVERT-01: one original activation/creation/use has one global conversion entitlement across its recipients, pulses, descendants and all Singularity owners. The first eligible local absorption claims it, even if other uncaptured portions survive; this is explicitly a per-source allowance, NOT proportional damage conservation. No further partial interception pays again. Record the source's genuine ordinary baseRP actually paid after all prices, independently of rank, extras and protected principal. Wait until that source's actual resolution-triggered base refunds are settled. For paidBase>0, let U=max(0,paidBase-actualBaseRefunded); convert0 if U=0, otherwise max(1,floor(U/2)). For actually zero paid base or an unpriced magic source, convert1 intrinsic RP per original source-use, not per callback. Costs such as strain, optional feature extras, mandatory Dampening, Barrier X, Forge cycle principal, transfer value, item charge count, stored reserves, damage or nominal waived price are never added to this valuation. A refunded source's actual return is preserved; it is not reduced to finance Singularity. Existing delayed refund entitlements must be resolved/escrowed under their actual source before this bounded value settles; an unknown refund interface is a narrowly identified adapter prerequisite, not permission to speculate credit.

A stable continuous class/item enchantment has a stable source-establishment identity, so repeated entry, suppression or a new Singularity cannot farm it again. Real later independently paid/limited activations have their own use IDs. A free cantrip can lawfully generate1RP after absorption once per actual cast; actual Action, preparation, Refrain, concentration and other source limits still apply. This is an expressly new resource-generation choice, not an assertion of strict global RP conservation. Self/allied feeding is allowed unless that actual source prohibits conversion/refund/farming. A source expressly barred from resource generation produces0 conversion; absorption remains useful. Native transfer/draw/work/recovery postings do not mint fresh intrinsic conversion identities merely because a currency or counter changes. A Well draw or Conduit transfer retains its original generating source-use lineage; consume eligible underlying magic and consult that one original receipt, never the moved/reserved RP or an extra fallback1 per posting. The Conduit transfer itself still triggers no generation hook. The Well original source may be absorbed without resetting creation/receipt limits. Resonance Forge's explicit no-RP-from-dismantling/fixture-fuel protection yields0 for consuming that fixture, not a new harvesting exception. An actual interruption AFTER native transfer/draw/cycle commitment retains its spent principal/Action/use under that complete native rule; prevented preflight pays nothing. No spent principal becomes stored value to reclaim. An absorbed summon corpse/death record is not a new entitlement. No generic per-day cap or hidden rank ceiling is added.

An unknown payment record is not an unpriced source. A genuinely no-RP-interface source has explicit no-RP attribution; a source with missing required payment/refund evidence remains a pending conversion reconciliation, not guessed rank value or fallback1. Its lawful absorption can complete while its disputed credit remains ungranted until the actual record resolves, without redispatching its payload.

NEW RS9-RECIPIENT-01: credit the winning point's original caster into the same lawful personal RP pool that financed this point. There is no reserve, draw Action, pooled maximum, charge/RC conversion, loan or remote recipient selection. At final settlement use the actual current maximum and recovery permission; overflow or prohibited credit is lost. A dead/ended/missing recipient pool receives no credit. Ending the point after it has genuinely consumed an output does not re-create that output or cancel an already-earned pending conversion; settle the surviving receipt once to its original eligible owner. NEW RS9-ARBITRATE-01: apply RF9-ORDER-01. The point cannot absorb its own sustaining spell, conversion bookkeeping or source receipt. Different points do not share a blanket immunity: an already active older eligible point consumes a new intersecting point's formation before the new one establishes. Existing candidate competition uses oldest establishment then stable ID, once per local manifestation. No winner that already ended can act later in that operation queue. Local broad suppression has precedence; a suppressed point consumes nothing and banks no missed output. A legal source-specific termination operation directed at this point ignores only this target point's own absorption, just as the existing named antimagic termination bridge separates own protection; another operative point or different real suppression can still intercept it. This NEW exception prevents an automatically undispellable field without weakening its other absorption. Ordinary Counterspell acts only at actual cast time before formation. completeSpellSelections.name: Resonance Nexus (Supreme)
completeSpellSelections.nativePromise: Create a field where all magic is enhanced and Resonance costs are halved.
completeSpellSelections.procedure:
KEEP rank9/class17 Druid, Mage or Wizard through Conjuration, Action/120ft/V/S/F/base26RP. Supreme Nexus is this identity's display alias, not a new spell. NEW NS9-FIELD-01: create the fixed radius30ft field with60-elapsed-second concentration. Its effects are indiscriminate: allies, enemies and the creator can qualify. It provides BOTH enhancement and half RP costs; ordinary Resonance Nexus supplies only its own independently scoped-2 comparison.

NEW NS9-PRICE-01: use RF9-PRICE-01. For actual spells, the real original caster body must intersect the operative field at commitment after any incompatible old concentration is removed. For actual magical nonspell activation/service fees, use the real payer/performer's body at that actual new payment; independently named protected principal stays whole. Familiar/projected release origins do not relocate the payer. No price is modified retrospectively, no pending future credit finances this transaction, and an otherwise absent ordinary RP-price interface is not manufactured. Actual Reaction casts qualify; ordinary Ready is priced at preparation only. A field cannot finance its own creation or its incompatible same-owner concentration replacement. A different owner's already-operative field can. Movement, absorption, suppression or ending after payment never reprices/refunds the committed source. An existing quote rechecks actual eligibility atomically at commitment; an unaffordable final price never partially spends Influence or another resource.

NEW NS9-ENHANCE-01: enhancement is distinct from price and is evaluated at the actual surviving native output stage, after absorption. For a new direct spell/activated technique/item-use output, use its actual acting body (or genuinely autonomous item's origin), not an invented beam or recipient proxy. For a continuing freestanding emitter, use its real current anchor; for a continuing creature/item-attached property, its actual affected body/item supplies the local expression. This permits local ongoing magic created earlier to benefit without treating a remote concentrating caster as the emitter. Select one eligible Nexus across duplicates, oldest establishment then stable ID; distinct instances retain their own clocks. A pure transferred/reflected already-scaled child never qualifies for another output multiplier.

Every eligible magical application gains+2 integrity against a genuinely source-defined opposed counter/dispel/neutralization CHECK: increase that opponent check's DC by2, not source rank. This does not turn an automatic source-permitted removal or suppression into a check, bypass a protected remover, create a saving throw, alter victim save DC/attack bonus or prevent source expiry/concentration failure. At cast-time counter checks, use the actual pending caster/declared manifestation under the same lawful field test; price remains separate. Existing active qualitative magic therefore has a concrete protective enhancement without inventing additional truth, language, recipes or minds. The Nexus does not confer integrity on itself; another actual Nexus can, once, without recursive numerical amplification.

In addition, apply one efficacy axis to each genuine native output, in the following exact priority: (a) numeric damage/healing/tempHP/prevention grant: multiply the native eligible amount by5/4 with floor, after real dice/flats and before defenses or source gain caps; typed damage combines with Furnace under RF9-PROVENANCE-01; (b) actual magical travel/displacement or granted Speed: multiply its maximum eligible distance/Speed by5/4, preserving actual current movement spent, support, occupied body, legal endpoints and transport prohibitions; (c) newly generated magical creature with a real finite source profile: multiply its established maximumHP by5/4, adding the difference to its lawful creationHP without healing an unrelated real donor, duplicating charges or granting actions; (d) an independently granted numeric magical statistic/bonus/penalty magnitude: multiply its nonnegative native magnitude by5/4 with floor, then use the source's stacking/condition restrictions; (e) qualitative sensing, communication, manipulation or utility with an actual positive native range/radius: multiply that one operating range by5/4 while locally eligible, without adding contents/identity or an otherwise missing perception channel; (f) a qualitative output with no earlier applicable axis but an actual finite ELAPSED manifestation lifetime may establish at5/4 of that ordinary lifetime, unless its source separately protects its deadline. Marker-based next-turn windows, source hard caps, held/capture deadlines and finite control-opportunity counts never turn into fractional extra turns. If no lawful scalable axis exists, integrity remains the enhancement. This priority is per native output, not a license to multiply every field of one profile or reapply to a derived child value.

Damage/healing/prevention and newly created finite grants retain the offered enhanced value under their own lifecycle after formation; no later entry offers a refill. Continuing stat/Speed/utility-range expressions recalculate from the unenhanced native baseline and actual spent budget while local and resume the same baseline on exit; they do not stack themselves. A previously existing finiteHP pool/body is not retroactively healed on entry. An actual-paid-base Barrier pool is first5×(actual retained base+fullX); only then the new independent enhancement multiplier may increase the offered prevention, with that bonus explicitly separate from paid-base credit. Same-name pool comparison, caps and exclusions still apply.

Protected numeric domains are not efficacy magnitudes: RP/RC generation or transfer, stored/reserved principal, RP/RC or charge-pool maxima/refill quantities, uses/charges, casting rank, targets/extra copies, Actions/Reactions/turns, cooldown/recharge, time of payment, field geometry/conversion multipliers, dependency budgets and source explicitly nonamplifiable results remain exact. These three resource fields never amplify their own or one another's radii, duration,1.5/1.25 coefficients,half-price operation or conversion ledger; their useful field benefits remain and they may receive the one integrity benefit from a DIFFERENT Nexus. The restriction prevents recursive meta-amplification, not a reclassification of ordinary combat/item/utility magic as ineligible. Conduit/Transfusion principal, Forge cycle5, the actual Reservoir/Soulburn combination and copied-feat caps are not rewritten. The owner-set Mass Suggestion24-hour maximum, actual capture/observation/entitlement deadlines, Sequester consent/wake boundary, regular-turn and death/Stable clocks, and Rank7 derivative resource or agency limits are protected contracts rather than efficacy ranges/durations. Such magic still gains the actual integrity benefit and any genuinely permitted separate output axis; no accepted Rank7 procedure or actual access is rewritten. Actual charge-only/item magic can gain enhancement without its charges being halved. Oracle RC remains RC with no new RP pool; actual removable magical outputs may enhance only within their own permitted source scope.

One Supreme half-price and one enhancement operation apply across duplicates. Ordinary Nexus's one-2 remains earlier, Dampening's spell-only+2 later, and Influence is final; field entry cannot repeatedly apply any of them. Furnace3/2 can multiply surviving eligible spell damage with Supreme5/4 once at the shared rational stage; source-specific class late riders retain their later stage. Suppression removes local enhancement and future pricing eligibility without erasing original deadlines, actual expenditures, consumed uses or already-established finite grants. Actual Greater Dispel or generator absorption ends the field through its actual source interface; no field becomes a source of crafting, hidden knowledge, unearned entitlement or a second resource refund.
